headline: Scheduled CANON-041 audit: investor nav mobile drawer fixed (overflow-y, bottom:0, env(safe-area-inset-*), 44px tap targets), botcheck aria-labels added on contact page, RUM ladder cache refreshed.

items.title: Investor nav mobile drawer upgraded to CANON-041 pattern
items.insight: The .inv-nav-mobile-menu had no bottom:0 and no overflow-y, making it truncate on tall link lists. Fixed to match the style.css .nav-center.open reference pattern with bottom:0, overflow-y:auto, overscroll-behavior:contain, env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and 44px min tap targets.

items.title: Both contact page botcheck inputs now carry aria-label
items.insight: The footer botcheck (class=footer-dispatch-bot) had aria-hidden but no aria-label. The playwright-axe test filters by offsetHeight which can catch it if footer-dispatch.js CSS injection hasn't fired. Both botchecks now have aria-label='Leave this unchecked'.
